=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5601 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry loop’s early-break condition requires `merge_state` to be non-empty and not `unknown` even when `mergeable` is already `true` or `false`, so it can keep polling unnecessarily.
  WHY: This can add up to ~50s of avoidable latency and extra API calls when GitHub has already returned a definitive mergeability result; reviewers disagreed only on whether empty `merge_state` is a separate edge case, but all flagged the same root cause.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5584-5586 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The assignment `_STD_ITER_PR_NUM_CACHED="${_std_conflict_pr_num_try}"` inside the retry loop is redundant.
  WHY: The PR number is already known and does not change during retries, so this adds no functional value and only reduces clarity.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5583-5602 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry loop does not check whether the PR becomes `closed` or `merged` before continuing mergeability polling.
  WHY: This can waste a few extra API calls before the post-loop guard runs, but the finding was only raised by one reviewer.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5593-5602 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The early-break condition requires `merge_state` to be non-empty (`[ -n "${_std_attempt_merge_state}" ]`) when `mergeable` is true/false, so polling can continue even after GitHub has returned a definitive mergeability result.
  WHY: If GitHub returns `mergeable=true` or `mergeable=false` with an empty `merge_state`, the loop will not exit early and may continue through all retry attempts.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5584 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The assignment `_STD_ITER_PR_NUM_CACHED="${_std_conflict_pr_num_try}"` is redundant.
  WHY: `_STD_ITER_PR_NUM_CACHED` was already set earlier and `_std_conflict_pr_num_try` is derived from it, so this is only a code clarity issue.
- `README.md, agents.md`:line 1 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Documentation updates mentioned in the PR description are not reflected in the last run changed files list.
  WHY: This suggests potential documentation-code drift, although the reviewer noted these files appear in the original PR diff and may already be updated.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5601 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The retry loop continues to poll mergeability even when it is already definitive if the state string is still `unknown`.
  WHY: If `mergeable="false"`, the PR is already definitely conflicted, but the loop still waits for `merge_state` to become non-`unknown`, adding unnecessary stall-recovery latency.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5585-5586 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The assignment `_STD_ITER_PR_NUM_CACHED="${_std_conflict_pr_num_try}"` inside the retry loop is redundant.
  WHY: `_STD_ITER_PR_NUM_CACHED` is already set earlier and the PR number does not change within the loop, so this is only a minor clarity issue.
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:5541 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The minimal JSON payload used to seed the cache may be insufficiently robust.
  WHY: The reviewer flagged a possible `jq` failure if the cached PR number is empty and noted that a minimal payload lacking the `state` field can cause downstream guard logic to fail open until the retry loop fetches full JSON.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
